offline: Nta murandasi ufite. Ubutumwa buzavugururwa niwongera kugira murandasi.

bell.title: Ubutumwa
bell.loadFailed: Ntibyashobotse gufungura ubutumwa. Kanda wongere ugerageze.

inbox.title: Ubutumwa
inbox.emptyBody: Imenyesha ry'umutekano, amatangazo n'amakuru y'iki kigo bigaragara hano.

settings.title: Igenamiterere ry'ubutumwa
settings.intro: Uko MediLink ikumenyesha ubutumwa bushya kuri iki gikoresho.
settings.conflict: Ibyo wahisemo biracyahari. Fungura verisiyo nshya, hanyuma wongere ubike.
settings.soundHint: Ntirivuga mu buryo busanzwe. Rivuga gusa umaze gukanda cyangwa kwandika kuri paji.
settings.testBlocked: Mushakisha yawe yahagaritse ijwi. Reba ko iyi tab idacecekeshejwe.
settings.languageHint: Rukoreshwa mu butumwa, imeyili n'iyi porogaramu.
settings.digestHint: Akira buri busabe bukiza, cyangwa incamake imwe ku munsi.

announcements.facilityIntro: Menyesha abarwayi ko hafunzwe cyangwa hari impinduka, cyangwa ushyire itangazo kuri ekarani y'icyumba cyo gutegereza.
announcements.platformIntro: Ubutumwa bwa MediLink ku bakozi b'ibigo byose.
announcements.empty: Andika itangazo, ubike nk'umushinga, hanyuma uritangaze ryiteguye.

audience.patients_in_range: Abarwayi bafite gahunda kuri aya matariki

audienceHint.patients_in_range: Abafite gahunda cyangwa itike kuri iki kigo muri ayo matariki, n'ababarera.
audienceHint.display: Rigaragara kuri ekarani y'icyumba cyo gutegereza. Nta muntu umenyeshwa.
audienceHint.all_facilities: Buri mukozi ukora mu bigo byose. Abayobozi b'ibigo nabo bakira imeyili.

announcements.composerIntro: Andika muri buri rurimi abarwayi bawe bakoresha. Nta makuru y'ubuvuzi, nta miyoboro.
announcements.fixErrors: Banza ukosore ibi mbere yo kubika
announcements.conflict: Hari undi wahinduye iri tangazo. Ongera ufungure paji urebe verisiyo ye.
announcements.selectedLater: Guhitamo ibigo bimwe bizaza hamwe n'urutonde rw'ibigo.

priorityHint.routine: Mu butumwa; push n'imeyili hanze y'amasaha y'ituze.
priorityHint.important: Ku mpinduka zireba gahunda z'uyu munsi cyangwa ejo.

announcements.textHint: Umutwe ugeze ku nyuguti 120, ubutumwa bugeze ku 1.000, muri buri rurimi.
announcements.missing: Ntiryanditse mu {{languages}}. Abakoresha izo ndimi bazabona inyandiko yo mu {{fallback}}.
announcements.bodyHint: Nta ndwara, amazina y'ibizamini cyangwa imiyoboro.

confirmPublish.platform: Utangaze iri tangazo ku bigo byose?

announcements.confirmPublishBody: Ntirizongera guhindurwa rimaze gutangazwa. Ushobora kurikuraho nyuma.
announcements.confirmWithdrawBody: Ubutumwa butaroherezwa burahagarikwa, kandi ibiri mu butumwa bigashyirwaho ko byakuweho.
announcements.previewEmpty: Andika umutwe n'ubutumwa urebe uko bizagaragara.
